infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Spotted uses your location to show which friends are nearby and detect when you arrive at venues.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Spotted uses background location to notify you when friends arrive at venues and auto-detect your check-ins, even when the app is closed. Your location is only shared with friends you choose.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Spotted uses motion detection to save battery while tracking your venue.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Spotted uses the camera so you can capture and share moments from your night.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Spotted uses the microphone to record sound in your videos. Without it, videos are silent.

plugins.photosPermission: Spotted shows the photos you took during last night's stops in your private Morning After, and your latest photo as a shortcut to your library. Photos you don't share never leave your device.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Spotted can save captured photos and videos to your library.

plugins.photosPermission: Spotted lets you share photos from your library in your posts.
plugins.cameraPermission: Spotted uses the camera so you can capture and share moments from your night.

plugins.contactsPermission: Spotted uses your contacts to find friends and choose two people for the next wave. The nominees you submit are saved for invitations.
